tagline: Live public data, presented so you can trust it: every tool fetches from the source API in your browser, and every chart declares what one row counts, what it cannot answer, and which framing choices were made. Adding a dataset is one JSON file. Adding a tool is one HTML file and one manifest line.

tools.badge: Live · fetches the city's API when you search
tools.title: What does that grade in the window actually mean?
tools.blurb: Type any NYC restaurant. See the score, this restaurant's own history, and what the inspector actually found — because a good number and a fixed building are not the same thing.

tools.badge: Live · fetches the city's API when you search
tools.title: You failed the inspection. What do you fix first?
tools.blurb: Your open violations, ranked by how often that exact code was still there at the re-inspection. Measured across 6,960 paired NYC inspections — so the order is evidence, not a guess about what looks worst.

tools.title: Watch a true chart become a false one
tools.blurb: One chart, pinned to your screen, spun one display lever at a time. No number changes at any point — that is the lesson.
